description: This file is a shell script used to manage the lifecycle of an IGMP snooper service, including starting and stopping it, handling system events, and managing associated process IDs and system configurations.

methods.name: do_stop_igmp_snooper
methods.description: Stops the IGMP snooper process if it is running by killing its process ID read from a pid file.

methods.name: do_start_igmp_snooper
methods.description: Starts the IGMP snooper with appropriate options based on system configuration and saves its process ID.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service parameters by retrieving configuration values from the system context.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the IGMP snooper service, changing system event states accordingly.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the IGMP snooper service, updating system event states.
